title: Research
text:
IN PROGRESS · PYTHON / STATISTICS / EQUITIES
A developing Python-based project for investigating listed equities through statistical analysis. As the work matures, this page can hold the research question, dataset, methodology, limitations, findings and code.



Question: What exactly should be measured, and why?
Method: Document assumptions and how they are tested.
Results: Publish only when verified and reproducible.

title: About
